messages:
Maya (PM): Quick kickoff  need to winnow the observability launch surface for GA. Customers have three consistent asks: per-tenant cost, tracing hooks for latency tails, grouped error analytics. Can we align scope in this thread?
Sam (Eng): +1. My concern: tracing hooks might add overhead at high qps. We need to decide targeted instrumentation vs always-on sampling.
Jordan (SRE): Strong vote for targeted hooks. Broad tracing doubles IO on sidecars. Prefer async export + circuit breaker.
Lee (Data): For cost breakdown we can ship a route-level % first. Per-tenant needs request attribution pipeline which exists but requires sampling to be cheap.
Ruth (Customer Success): Sales wants a visible per-tenant cost card and top error groups. If we show those in Console, it unlocks several deals.
Maya (PM): Proposed GA-minimum surface: dashboards (ops, cost, errors), tracing hooks (targeted for top slow endpoints), cost breakdown (route % + lightweight per-tenant card), error analytics (grouped by stack tag). Accept?
Sam (Eng): Sounds pragmatic. Implementation sketch:
```
- Tracing hooks attached at router -> model boundary
- Sampling: 1% global, 100% for error responses for the selected endpoints
- Export: async to observability pipeline (no sync disk writes on hot path)
```
Jordan (SRE): Also add exporter circuit-breaker and backpressure handling. Retention defaults proposal: traces 14d, aggregates 90d.
Lee (Data): Route-level cost will rely on inference logs + model cost table; expect ~5-10% variance initially. We'll annotate UI with an "estimated accuracy" tooltip.
Ruth (Customer Success): Please include CSV export for customers and a short tooltip text for accuracy to help conversations. I'll draft customer-facing language.
Maya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria:
```
- Ops dashboard: shows p50/p95/p99 for top routes
- Cost card: route % and per-tenant card (estimated) in Console
- Tracing: instrument top 5 endpoints with targeted spans and error capture
- Error analytics: group by exception type and show top 10 traces per group
- Perf: <=5% CPU increase on serving hosts in perf tests
```
Sam (Eng): I'll own tracing + perf gate. Plan: spike then perf run over 2 sprints.
Jordan (SRE): I'll own perf tests and define SLO rollback thresholds for tracing.
Lee (Data): I'll deliver the backend for the cost card and thin UI by end of sprint. Tooltip will link to docs.
Ruth (Customer Success): I'll collect top-8 customer asks and prepare a one-pager for launch notes.
Maya (PM): Owners set: Sam tracing, Jordan perf gating, Lee cost card, Ruth comms. Next sync Thursday 09:00. Blockers?
Sam (Eng): Need infra quota for async exporter (kafka topic)  filing ticket now.
Jordan (SRE): Added exporter-failure alert template to runbook.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: obs-instrumentation/spike -> staging at 2025-04-11T18:00Z :rocket:
Ruth (Customer Success): :thumbsup: customers happy with minimal scope. If we can demo per-tenant cost + error groups, it's a win.
Maya (PM): I'll update roadmap doc and create GH acceptance checklist. Thanks all. :eyes:
